drafter.private_reasoning: The draft leaves payment undefined and the release overly broad. The proposed opening amount is subject to client approval and does not disclose confidential settlement instructions. Confirm party identities and settlement scope before execution.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial proposed revisions for discussion, subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement. We propose a $6,000,000 settlement payment, with the release effective only upon receipt of cleared funds. We have also clarified payment timing, release scope, and customary confidentiality exceptions. Please confirm the parties’ full legal names and identify the claims and proceeding to be resolved.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 6,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff, within ten business days after the date on which all parties have executed this Agreement (the “Effective Date”). No release under this Agreement shall become effective until Plaintiff receives the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising on or before the Effective Date out of the dispute identified in the Recitals. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement, claims arising after the Effective Date, or rights or claims that cannot lawfully be waived. The parties shall identify the dispute and any pending proceeding with specificity before execution.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; disclosures reasonably necessary to obtain legal, tax, or financial advice or to enforce this Agreement; and disclosures to governmental or regulatory authorities. Persons receiving disclosures for professional advice shall be informed of their confidential nature. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits legally protected reporting, cooperation with governmental authorities, or disclosures that applicable law does not permit the parties to restrict.
